description: Part clamp confirmed. CNC cycle initiated in AUTO mode.
Spindle reached target speed 12000 RPM. Tool T04 engaged.
Warning: Coolant flow sensor FL-102 below nominal lower limit (1.1 bar).
Spindle bearing thermocouple TC-01 exceeded caution threshold 70.0 C.
Spindle vibration accelerometer ACC-02 exceeded safety limit (6.4 mm/s).
Emergency shutdown executed by PLC watchdog: Spindle bearing thermal expansion trip.
Front safety enclosure interlock opened manually.
Operator HMI acknowledged error code ERR_E07.
Maintenance diagnostic key activated. PLC transitioned to MAINTENANCE_HOLD.
Part clamp released. Workpiece marked SCRAP by QA supervisor.
